enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Bend knees. Turn onto back. Breathe slowly. Remain motionless.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Sit on chair. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Insert card into fare box. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a Health Care Professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Write notes. Walk to nurses station. Use computer. Answer phone. Talk to colleague. Walk to another patient room. Check patient. Administer treatment. Write report. Eat lunch. Return to work.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Walk to bedroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Add meat. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Rinse plate.

Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open browser. Browse internet. Open social media. Watch video. Open game. Play game. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue game. Close game. Shut down laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply shampoo. Scrub hair. Rinse hair. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Bend knees. Breathe slowly.
